name: mirage
text: Sorry for the wait. You're right, and the engine's own numbers show it. In its last live pass it judged 29,690 lines and offered 0. Every skip reason is about Pinnacle: price not settled 10,872, line closed 10,148, ask is not an old Pinnacle price 5,896. The taker lane only buys when Pinnacle has just moved and Novig still shows Pinnacle's old price. That is rare by design, and Pinnacle's in-play lines are often closed. The lanes that don't need Pinnacle (score events and the model) are running in practice mode. They are 5-0 so far, but that's far too few to trust. Next I'll make the Pinnacle-free lanes carry the Practice mode and use Pinnacle only as a check when its price is fresh. I'll show you the practice fills and CLV before anything goes to Real. It's in TASKS.md as LV2.
